title: Oven Roasted Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A charred, dense, and indulgent Mediterranean dish featuring lamb, white wine vinegar, and a flaky puff pastry crust, all cooked to perfection in a hot pot vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the white wine vinegar, olive oil, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
In a large hot pot vessel, arrange a layer of onion and garlic.
Add the marinated lamb on top of the onion and garlic layer.
Place the puff pastry rectangle over the lamb, pressing the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the lamb is tender.
